payload.title: Web action gates (permission-matrix, sensor-permission-matrix, useCanMutate) are hand-picked mirrors of backend @Roles decided on users.role and cover a handful of mutations, so every unlisted UI action is offered whether or not the API accepts it
evidence: web/shared-ui/src/authz/permission-matrix.ts:1-6 (mirror of the farm-service permission matrix, a subset)
web/shared-ui/src/authz/permission-matrix.ts:26-33 (scope rule: only the handful of mutations the UI surfaces are mirrored)
web/shared-ui/src/authz/useCanMutate.ts:30-53 (gate is membership of user.role in the mirrored list)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-34 goal (the UI cannot offer what the API refuses) and the repo rule against hand-maintained copies of a single source of truth.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-34, release R10.
